description: This file defines the interface for AT command channel communication in the Android telephony stack, including error codes, data structures for responses, function prototypes for sending commands, and callback management.

methods.name: at_open
methods.description: Opens a communication channel with the AT command interface, registering an unsolicited response handler.

methods.name: at_set_on_timeout
methods.description: Sets a callback function to be invoked on timeout events.

methods.name: at_set_on_reader_closed
methods.description: Sets a callback function to be invoked when the input stream is closed.

methods.name: at_send_command_singleline
methods.description: Sends an AT command expecting a single line response with a specific prefix.

methods.name: at_send_command_numeric
methods.description: Sends an AT command expecting a numeric response.

methods.name: at_send_command_multiline
methods.description: Sends an AT command expecting multiple lines of response with a specific prefix.

methods.name: at_handshake
methods.description: Performs a handshake with the AT command interface.

methods.name: at_send_command_sms
methods.description: Sends an AT command related to SMS, including PDU data.

methods.name: at_response_free
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for an ATResponse structure.

methods.name: at_get_cme_error
methods.description: Retrieves the CME error code from an ATResponse.
